explanation: The word comes from al-Khwarizmi, a ninth-century scholar in Baghdad. The title of one of his books also gave English the word algebra.

claims.text: An algorithm is a step-by-step procedure for solving a problem.
A compiler translates programs, a protocol is a set of rules for communication and a database stores data; none of them is the general name for such a procedure.
The word algorithm comes from the name of al-Khwarizmi, a ninth-century scholar who worked in Baghdad.
The word algebra comes from al-jabr, part of the title of one of al-Khwarizmi's books.
